storage.notes: SD card slot (up to 32 GB SDHC / 2 TB SDXC); iSCSI; FTP/Dropbox posting

features: Built-in microphone, two-way audio, audio alarm
76 dB WDR; true day/night mechanical filter
Intelligent Dynamic Noise Reduction; Content Based Imaging Technology
Multiple H.264 streams plus M-JPEG; upright 400x720 mode; ROI / E-PTZ
Simultaneous analog CVBS output (2.5 mm jack)
Bundled 3.3-12 mm IR-corrected varifocal DC-iris lens (manual focus)
dimensions_mm: 55 x 64 x 149 (H x W x D, with lens)

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.

release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (NBN_50022_Data_sheet_enUS_13659371787.pdf, V23 2022). NBN-50022-V3 = camera with 3.3-12 mm DC-iris F1.4 IR-corrected lens; FOV wide 110 x 58, tele 34 x 18 (H x V). Sensitivity 0.25 lx color / 0.05 lx mono (3200K, F1.4, 30 IRE). Datasheet ordering information states NDAA compliant.
